The stored look now comes back on its own, without the page having to reload.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A cleared browser still showed defaults, with the right settings already stored** ([#191](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/191)). Restoring the look ended in a page reload, because the language and the advanced view are read once when the interface starts. That reload was allowed only once per tab, as a safeguard against reloading in circles, and a tab that was restored or that stayed open while its site data was cleared had already used it up. The settings arrived, nothing reloaded, and the page sat there in English on a white background. It now applies each setting where it stands, so nothing has to reload and nothing can be skipped.
- Whether a Fleet peer card shows its scorecard is kept with the rest of the look now, so it also survives a new browser.
